Team Must Choose One
New Fire Lookout

One tower opens. It will watch for ten summers.

Our game show prize will pay a fire lookout for ten summers. Lookouts have watched North American forests for over a hundred years. Our old tower needs a partner tower to find each fire. Each tower reads an angle, and the angles cross at the smoke. Near Tower stands close to ours and sees into our valley. Far Tower stands across the forest and sees much more land.

THE QUESTION BEFORE US

Which would be better for our community, Near Tower or Far Tower?

CHOOSE YOUR SIDE
